Blue and red tides in the Chesapeake Bay Watershed: Examining political and environmental framings of collective action during the 2016 and 2020 elections
abstract: Watersheds require collective care and management at local and regional levels to maintain their ecological health. The Chesapeake Bay’s last several decades of stagnantly poor ecological health presents a distinctive case study for explicating the challenges of motivating collective action across a diverse regional natural resource. Our study uses county- and individual-level descriptive analysis to examine interrelated framings of environmental quality, environmental sentiment, and political action at two critical moments in time—the 2016 and 2020 presidential elections. We find that demographic, environmental, and political characteristics vary with distance to the Chesapeake Bay and that linked environmental and political characteristics appeared to become more polarized between 2016 and 2020. We found no evidence that local environmental quality influenced new political actions such as voting; however, people already likely to vote were influenced by their pro-environmental values such as priorities around climate change.
abstract_zh: 流域的生态健康需要地方和区域层面的集体关怀与管理来维持。切萨皮克湾（Chesapeake Bay）数十年来生态健康状况持续不佳，为阐释在多样化区域自然资源上激励集体行动所面临的挑战提供了一个独特案例。本研究采用县级和个体层面的描述性分析，考察了环境质量、环境态度与政治行动之间相互关联的框架，时间节点选取了2016年和2020年两次总统选举这两个关键时刻。我们发现，人口、环境和政治特征随与切萨皮克湾的距离而有所差异，且环境与政治特征的关联在2016年至2020年间似乎变得更加两极化。我们没有发现证据表明当地环境质量影响了投票等新的政治行动；然而，原本就可能投票的人，会受到其亲环境价值观（如对气候变化的重视）的影响。

title: Estimating effects of monsoon flooding on household water access
abstract: The importance of climate in water resources management is well recognized, but less is known about how climate affects water access at the household level. Understanding this is crucial for identifying vulnerable households, reducing health and well-being risks, and finding equitable solutions. Using difference-in-differences regression analyses and relying on temporal variation in interview timing from multiple, cross-sectional surveys, we examine the effects of monsoon riverine flooding on household water access among 34 000 households in Bangladesh in 2011 and 2014. We compare water access, a combined measure of both water source and time for collection, among households living in flood-affected and non-flood-affected districts before and after monsoon flooding events. We find that households in monsoon flood-affected districts surveyed after the flooding had between 2.27 and 4.42 times higher odds of experiencing low water access. Separating geographically, we find that while households in coastal districts have lower water access than those in non-coastal districts, monsoon flood exposure is a stronger predictor of low water access in non-coastal districts. Non-coastal districts were particularly burdened in 2014, when households affected by monsoon flooding had 4.71 times higher odds of low water access. We also find that household wealth is a consistent predictor of household water access. Overall, our results show that monsoon flooding is associated with a higher prevalence of low water access; socioeconomically vulnerable households are especially burdened.
abstract_zh: 气候对水资源管理的重要性已得到广泛认可，但人们对气候如何影响家庭层面的水资源可及性了解较少。理解这一点对于识别脆弱家庭、降低健康和福祉风险以及寻找公平的解决方案至关重要。我们利用双重差分（DiD）回归分析，并依托多次横截面调查中访谈时间的时间变化，考察了2011年和2014年季风期河流洪水对孟加拉国34000户家庭水资源可及性的影响。我们比较了季风洪水事件前后，受洪水影响与未受洪水影响地区家庭的水资源可及性（综合衡量水源类型与取水时间的指标）。我们发现，在洪水后接受调查的、位于季风洪水影响地区的家庭，其出现低水资源可及性的几率高出2.27至4.42倍。按地理区域划分，我们发现沿海地区家庭的水资源可及性低于非沿海地区，但在非沿海地区，季风洪水暴露是低水资源可及性更强的预测因素。2014年，非沿海地区承受的负担尤为沉重，受季风洪水影响的家庭出现低水资源可及性的几率高出4.71倍。我们还发现，家庭财富是家庭水资源可及性的一个稳定预测因素。总体而言，我们的结果表明，季风洪水与低水资源可及性的较高患病率相关；社会经济脆弱的家庭承受的负担尤为沉重。

title: Forest fires, smoky kitchens, and human health in Indonesia
abstract: Burning tropical forests to establish lucrative agricultural crops ignores potentially important health externalities of the resulting air pollution. These health externalities are often poorly understood, especially if other environmental hazards, such as indoor pollution, are not taken into account. Given the potential for joint, contemporaneous harms, we estimate the impacts of outdoor and indoor air pollution on respiratory health in Indonesia. To address the endogeneity of air pollution exposure, we use panel fixed effects estimation and instrument for outdoor pollution using upwind forest fire intensity. We find that outdoor air pollution exposure reduces lung capacity and decreases overall health status. Subgroup analysis reveals that these impacts are higher among the youngest and oldest individuals in our sample. Critically, we find suggestive evidence that outdoor air pollution exposure is more harmful to the health of individuals living in households that use clean cooking fuels. Thus, policies aimed at reducing environmental health harms are not substitutable—that is, reductions in both indoor and outdoor air pollution exposures are necessary for achieving health targets.
abstract_zh: 为建立利润丰厚的农业作物而焚烧热带森林，忽视了由此产生的空气污染可能带来的重要健康外部性。这些健康外部性往往理解不足，特别是如果未将室内污染等其他环境危害纳入考虑。鉴于可能存在的同时发生的复合危害，我们估计了室外和室内空气污染对印度尼西亚呼吸系统健康的影响。为解决空气污染暴露的内生性问题，我们使用面板固定效应估计，并以上风向的森林火灾强度作为室外污染的工具变量。我们发现，室外空气污染暴露会降低肺活量，并使总体健康状况变差。分组分析表明，这些影响在样本中最年轻和最年长的人群中更为严重。尤为关键的是，我们发现有初步证据表明，室外空气污染暴露对使用清洁烹饪燃料的家庭中个体的健康更为有害。因此，旨在减少环境健康危害的政策之间不可相互替代——也就是说，要实现健康目标，必须同时减少室内和室外的空气污染暴露。

title: Improved water and sanitation in early life and cognition in adolescence: Evidence from four countries
abstract: Early life environmental exposures, such as drinking water quality and sanitation, can have long lasting effects on human capital accumulation. Using matched samples of over 8000 children across Ethiopia, India, Peru, and Vietnam, this paper examines the relationship between early life access to improved drinking water and improved sanitation and cognition at the age of fifteen. It finds that children with early life access to improved drinking water score 1.6–2.8 percentage points higher on math, reading, and vocabulary tests. A similar, yet less precisely measured, pattern emerges for early life access to improved sanitation. Analysis by gender shows that the effects of early life drinking water access are stronger and more precise among girls. An examination of pathways underlying these relationships provides preliminary evidence that learning over the life course is a leading mechanism. Quantifying these long-term cognitive benefits provides insight for directing and prioritizing resources for global efforts to increase equitable access to improved drinking water and sanitation.
abstract_zh: 早期生活中的环境暴露，如饮用水质量和卫生设施，可能对人力资本积累产生长期影响。本文使用埃塞俄比亚、印度、秘鲁和越南四国超过8000名儿童的匹配样本，考察了儿童早期获得改善饮用水和改善卫生设施与其15岁时认知能力之间的关系。研究发现，早期获得改善饮用水的儿童，在数学、阅读和词汇测试中的得分高出1.6至2.8个百分点。早期获得改善卫生设施也呈现出类似但测量较不精确的规律。按性别分析显示，早期获得饮用水的影响在女孩中更强、也更精确。对背后作用路径的考察提供了初步证据，表明整个生命历程中的学习是主要机制。量化这些长期认知收益，为指导和优先安排全球资源以提高改善饮用水和卫生设施的公平可及性提供了依据。

title: Lost dividends from incomplete energy access transitions: Evidence from Honduras
Satellite-derived, smartphone-delivered geospatial cholera risk information for vulnerable populations
Social setting, gender, and preferences for improved sanitation: Evidence from experimental games in rural India
abstract: Unimproved sanitation and hygiene practices present a persistent threat to public health and well-being. Increasing the adoption of safe hygiene and sanitation requires both technological investments as well as behavioral change, suggesting that social contexts may be important in determining the success of efforts towards improved sanitation and hygiene. We examine how the social setting, particularly the gender balance of decision-making spaces, influences stated preferences for improving sanitation using a lab-in-the-field experiment. We designed a sanitation-themed public goods game in which participants made contributions that corresponded to varying levels of sanitation and hygiene investments. We implemented these games with over 1500 participants in 69 villages in rural Bihar and Odisha, India, randomly varying group gender composition (women only, men only, and mixed gender). Our study finds that individuals playing in single gender groups make larger contributions; these increases are driven by women playing in groups with only women. In mixed gender groups, contributions increase with the share of male participants and over rounds played. We also find that preferences elicited via experimental games are correlated with revealed preferences for hygiene and sanitation – game behavior and sanitation practices are positively correlated for men and negatively correlated for women. Collectively, our findings suggest that sanitation promotion programs, which rightfully focus on community mobilization, could be more effective if they explicitly incorporated gender preferences and considered the social decision-making environment in their design
abstract_zh: 不达标的卫生设施和卫生习惯对公众健康与福祉构成持续威胁。要提高安全卫生设施的采用率，既需要技术投资，也需要行为改变，这表明社会情境可能在改善卫生设施的努力能否成功方面发挥重要作用。我们利用田野实验室实验，考察社会情境——特别是决策空间中的性别构成——如何影响人们对改善卫生设施的陈述偏好。我们设计了一个以卫生设施为主题的公共物品博弈，参与者的捐献分别对应不同水平的卫生设施投资。我们在印度比哈尔邦和奥里萨邦的69个村庄中，对1500多名参与者开展了这些博弈，并随机改变小组的性别构成（仅女性、仅男性和男女混合）。我们的研究发现，在单一性别小组中博弈的个人捐献更多；这种增长主要由仅有女性的小组中的女性推动。在男女混合小组中，捐献随男性参与者比例的增加以及博弈轮次的推进而增加。我们还发现，通过实验博弈所获得的偏好，与卫生习惯的显示性偏好相关——对男性而言，博弈行为与卫生设施做法呈正相关，而对女性而言则呈负相关。总之，我们的研究结果表明，卫生设施推广项目（其重点在于社区动员，这一点无可厚非）如果在设计中明确纳入性别偏好，并考虑社会决策环境，可能会更加有效

title: Seasonal variation in household water insecurity in rural Bangladesh: A longitudinal analysis
abstract: Billions of people globally are at risk for severe water scarcity periodically throughout the year. Moreover, intensifying climate change and increasingly unpredictable weather patterns will increase the severity and scope of those affected by household water insecurity, with negative consequences on household health and wellbeing. Faced with water insecurity, households shift to alternative water sources, which may be more expensive or of lower quality and contribute to both financial and health burdens. The extent to which household water insecurity varies throughout the year, however, remains understudied. Using a panel dataset of 2014 households across 40 villages in Matlab, Bangladesh, we test for seasonal variation in household water insecurity and its determinants using a modified HWISE scale. We find that while water insecurity in Matlab was low both pre- and post-monsoon, household water experiences vary throughout the year. Households report significantly lower water insecurity post-monsoon, compared to pre-monsoon, suggesting an annual measure of household water insecurity is insufficient to fully characterize intra-annual household water experiences. Comparing determinants of household water insecurity, we find that geography, household water use behaviors, and household characteristics are significantly related to experiences of household water insecurity but vary in their extent depending on the season. Our results demonstrate that physical location, seasonality, water quality, and household-level factors contribute to the dynamic nature of intra-annual household water insecurity. Knowing when and to what extent such determinants influence household water experiences throughout the year is essential for guiding and adapting engineering and policy design to reduce the costs and consequences of household water insecurity.
abstract_zh: 全球有数十亿人周期性地面临严重的水资源短缺风险，且全年皆然。此外，日益加剧的气候变化和越来越难以预测的天气模式，将扩大受家庭水资源不安全影响的人群规模和范围，并对家庭健康与福祉造成负面后果。面对水资源不安全，家庭会转向其他水源，而这些水源可能更昂贵或质量更低，从而同时加重经济和健康负担。然而，家庭水资源不安全在一年之内的变化程度仍研究不足。利用孟加拉国Matlab地区40个村庄中2014年家庭的面板数据集，我们采用修正后的HWISE量表，检验了家庭水资源不安全的季节性变化及其决定因素。我们发现，Matlab地区的水资源不安全程度在季风前后均较低，但家庭的用水体验在全年内存在变化。与季风前相比，季风后家庭报告的水资源不安全程度显著更低，这表明年度性的家庭水资源不安全测度不足以全面刻画年内的家庭用水体验。在比较家庭水资源不安全的决定因素时，我们发现地理位置、家庭用水行为和家庭特征均与家庭水资源不安全体验显著相关，但其影响程度因季节而异。我们的结果表明，自然地理位置、季节性、水质以及家庭层面的因素共同导致了年内家庭水资源不安全的动态变化。了解这些决定因素何时、在多大程度上影响家庭的用水体验，对于指导和调整工程与政策设计、降低家庭水资源不安全的成本和后果至关重要。

title: COVID-19, public health messaging, and sanitation and hygiene practices in rural India
venue: Journal of Water, Sanitation and Hygiene for Development
abstract: Despite the importance of safe sanitation and hygiene for sustainable development and public health, approximately half of India's rural population lacks access to safely managed sanitation. Policies prioritizing improved sanitation access have accelerated coverage, yet barriers to universal access and use remain. In this paper, we investigate how personal experience with a public health shock impacts recall of public health messages and households' sanitation and hygiene practices. Using a panel survey conducted before and after the first wave of the COVID-19 pandemic, and the resulting lockdown, in Bihar, India, we compare public health messaging recall and hygiene and sanitation behaviors among households that experienced severe economic disruptions due to the COVID-19 lockdown and those that did not. We find that households that experienced economic disruptions had a higher recall of public health messaging around safe sanitation and hygiene. In addition, households that experienced these disruptions reported more social distancing, increased handwashing behavior, and reduced open defecation. A major public health shock, the COVID-19 pandemic, increased messaging around the importance of safe hygiene and sanitation for public health in India. We find that personal experience increased the salience of public health messaging, with positive returns to sanitation and hygiene practices.
abstract_zh: 尽管安全卫生设施和卫生习惯对可持续发展和公共健康至关重要，但印度约一半的农村人口仍无法获得安全管理的卫生设施。优先改善卫生设施可及性的政策加快了覆盖率的提高，但普遍获得和使用卫生设施的障碍依然存在。在本文中，我们考察了个人经历公共卫生冲击如何影响其对公共卫生信息的回忆，以及家庭的卫生设施和卫生习惯。利用在印度比哈尔邦COVID-19大流行第一波及随之而来的封锁前后开展的追踪调查面板数据，我们比较了因封锁而遭受严重经济冲击的家庭与未遭受此类冲击的家庭，在公共卫生信息回忆以及卫生和卫生设施行为方面的差异。我们发现，经历经济冲击的家庭对安全卫生设施相关公共卫生信息的回忆率更高。此外，经历这些冲击的家庭报告了更多的社交距离、更多的洗手行为，以及更少的露天排便。一次重大的公共卫生冲击——COVID-19大流行——增强了印度关于安全卫生设施与公共健康重要性的宣传。我们发现，个人经历提高了公共卫生信息的显著性，并带来了卫生设施和卫生习惯方面的正向回报。

title: Climate and hydrological seasonal effects on household water insecurity: A systematic review
abstract:
Household water insecurity (HWI) can have far‐reaching consequences for human health and well‐being, yet little is known about how environmental seasonality contributes to HWI variation. Using a systematic literature review, we examined the following questions: (1) How does environmental seasonality affect HWI? and (2) How do the effects vary over time? We also highlighted strategic areas for future research. We conducted the search using Scopus, Web of Science, PubMed, ProQuest, and EBSCO Academic Search Complete, with an end search date of February 3, 2021; only English‐language studies were included. Articles were included in the review if analysis studied seasonal temperature, precipitation, or freshwater variation and individual or household experiences with household water adequacy, water reliability, water affordability, or water safety. Bias was evaluated via hand assessment, and articles of poor quality were excluded. Studies that focused on extreme weather events or water insecurity at community or watershed levels were omitted. We identified 67 articles, the majority of which were cross‐sectional (
n
= 46, 68.7%). Among longitudinal studies (
n
= 21, 31.3%), only one used a quantitative HWI scale, while the rest relied on proxies (
n
= 20, 95.2%). Our review also revealed literature gaps related to unequal coverage of freshwater ecosystem habitat types and forms of environmental seasonality. There is a need for more attention to extreme climate events, such as a prolonged multiyear drought. With changing climate expected to exacerbate weather patterns with serious implications, especially for vulnerable populations, understanding seasonality in HWI is important for crafting sustainable engineering and policy responses to water insecurity.

abstract_zh:
家庭水资源不安全（HWI）可能对人类健康和福祉产生深远影响，但人们对环境季节性如何导致HWI差异知之甚少。我们通过系统文献综述，考察了以下问题：（1）环境季节性如何影响HWI？（2）这些影响如何随时间变化？我们还指出了未来研究的战略领域。我们使用Scopus、Web of Science、PubMed、ProQuest和EBSCO Academic Search Complete进行检索，检索截止日期为2021年2月3日；仅纳入英文文献。若文献分析了季节性气温、降水或淡水变化，以及个人或家庭在用水充足性、供水可靠性、用水可负担性或水安全方面的体验，则纳入综述。偏倚通过人工评估进行，质量较差的文章被排除。专注于极端天气事件或社区及流域层面水资源不安全的研究被剔除。我们共识别出67篇文章，其中大多数为横截面研究（46篇，68.7%）。在纵向研究（21篇，31.3%）中，只有一项使用了定量的HWI量表，其余研究均依赖代理指标（20篇，95.2%）。我们的综述还揭示了文献空白，涉及淡水生态系统栖息地类型和环境季节性形式的覆盖不均问题。需要更多关注极端气候事件，例如持续多年的干旱。鉴于气候变化预计将加剧天气模式并带来严重影响，尤其是对脆弱人群而言，理解HWI的季节性对于制定可持续的工程与政策应对举措至关重要。

title: Sustaining latrine use: Peers, policies, and sanitation behaviors
venue: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
abstract: One third of the world's population lacks access to improved sanitation facilities with ramifications for health, human well-being, and economic development. Although household latrines offer a relatively cheap technological solution, initiatives for universal coverage have fallen short of their goals. In this paper, we analyze a unique panel dataset to examine policies and peer effects as drivers of household sanitation behaviors over time. Our data include nearly 1000 rural Indian households across 39 villages surveyed at five time points over a 14-year period during which two distinct sanitation policy interventions occurred. Using spatial data on household locations to define peer reference groups, we estimate how the sanitation behaviors of neighbors influence latrine use, both at the household level and by gender. We find evidence that, while external interventions can be effective in increasing latrine use in the short term, sustained household latrine use consistently depends on neighbors’ behavior. We also examine within- and across-group peer influences by examining patterns of latrine use among adult women and men. We find clear evidence that latrine use by neighboring women positively influences sanitation behaviors for both women and men, while latrine use among neighboring men has imprecisely estimated and small positive effects on men's behaviors and no effect on women's behaviors. These finding suggest that peer influences represent an important mechanism underlying household sanitation behavior, and policies that leverage these social effects, such as investments expanding women's access to sanitation and other drivers of behavior change, may be more effective and sustainable.
abstract_zh: 全球三分之一的人口无法获得改善的卫生设施，这对健康、人类福祉和经济发展都产生了影响。尽管家用厕所提供了一种相对廉价的技术解决方案，但实现普遍覆盖的举措未能达到预期目标。在本文中，我们利用一个独特的面板数据集，考察政策与同伴效应如何随时间推动家庭的卫生行为。我们的数据包括印度农村约1000户家庭，他们分布在39个村庄，在一段14年的时间里经过五个时间点的调查，期间发生了两次不同的卫生政策干预。我们利用家庭位置的空间数据定义同伴参照群体，估计邻居的卫生行为如何影响家庭层面以及按性别划分的厕所使用情况。我们发现，外部干预在短期内能有效提高厕所使用率，但持续的家庭厕所使用始终取决于邻居的行为。我们还通过考察成年女性和男性的厕所使用模式，检验了组内与跨组的同伴影响。我们发现明确的证据表明，邻近女性的厕所使用对女性和男性的卫生行为均具有正向影响；而邻近男性的厕所使用对男性行为具有估计不精确且较小的正向效应，对女性行为则无影响。这些发现表明，同伴影响是家庭卫生行为背后的一个重要机制，而利用这些社会效应的政策——例如扩大女性获得卫生设施的渠道以及其他行为改变的驱动因素的投资——可能会更为有效且更具可持续性。

title: Does improved risk information increase the value of cholera prevention? An analysis of stated vaccine demand in slum areas of urban Bangladesh
The effect of coal-fired power plant closures on emergency department visits for asthma-related conditions among 0- to 4-year-old children in Chicago, 2009-2017
abstract:
Objectives. To investigate the effects of coal-fired power plant closures on zip code–level rates of emergency department visits for asthma-related conditions among 0- to 4-year-old children in Chicago, Illinois.
Methods. We used data on wind, population, PM2.5 (particulates measuring ≤ 2.5 µm in diameter), and zip code–level rates of emergency department visits for asthma-related conditions among 0- to 4-year-old children between 2009 and 2017 in Chicago. The difference-in-differences research design compared rates of emergency department visits in zip codes near 3 coal-fired power plants before and after their closures to rates in zip codes farther away during the same time period.
Results. We found that emergency department visits for asthma-related conditions among 0- to 4-year-old children decreased by 12% in zip codes near the 3 coal-fired power plants following their closures relative to rates in zip codes farther away during the same period. The crude and age-specific rates of emergency department visits decreased by 2.41 visits per ten thousand inhabitants and 35.63 visits per ten thousand children aged 0 to 4 years, respectively.
Conclusions. Our findings demonstrate that closing coal-fired power plants can lead to improvements in the respiratory health of young children.
abstract_zh:
目的。考察燃煤电厂关停对伊利诺伊州芝加哥市0至4岁儿童因哮喘相关疾病而到急诊就诊的邮政编码区（ZIP code）级比率的影响。
方法。我们使用了2009年至2017年间芝加哥市的风向、人口、PM2.5（直径≤2.5 µm的颗粒物）数据，以及邮政编码区级别的0至4岁儿童哮喘相关急诊就诊率数据。双重差分研究设计比较了3座燃煤电厂附近邮政编码区在电厂关停前后的急诊就诊率，并与同期距离较远的邮政编码区的就诊率进行对照。
结果。我们发现，与同期距离较远的邮政编码区相比，3座燃煤电厂关停后，其附近邮政编码区中0至4岁儿童因哮喘相关疾病的急诊就诊率下降了12%。粗就诊率和年龄别就诊率分别下降了每万名居民2.41次就诊和每万名0至4岁儿童35.63次就诊。
结论。我们的研究结果表明，关停燃煤电厂可以改善幼儿的呼吸系统健康。

title: Balancing intersectoral demands in basin-scale planning: The case of Nepal's western river basins
The role of hydropower in visions of water resources development for rivers of Western Nepal
venue: International Journal of Water Resources Development
abstract: Water resources can play significant roles in development pathways for water-endowed, low-income countries like Nepal. This article describes three visions for water resource development in the Karnali and Mahakali Basins of Western Nepal: state-led development, demand-driven development and preservation of ecosystem integrity. The analysis calls attention to water use trade-offs, including those resulting from national priorities such as infrastructure-based hydropower and irrigation, from local drinking water demand, and from environmental conservation concerns. While these visions of water resources development do diverge, common trends appear, including acknowledgment of water management’s role in expanding energy access and increasing agricultural productivity.
abstract_zh: 对于水资源丰富、收入较低的国家（如尼泊尔）而言，水资源可以在其发展路径中发挥重要作用。本文描述了尼泊尔西部卡尔纳利（Karnali）和马哈卡利（Mahakali）流域水资源开发的三种设想：国家主导型开发、需求驱动型开发以及生态系统完整性保护。分析提请关注水资源利用中的权衡取舍，包括国家优先事项（如基于基础设施的水电和灌溉）、当地饮用水需求以及环境保护关切所带来的权衡。尽管这些水资源开发设想确有分歧，但也呈现出共同趋势，包括认识到水资源管理在扩大能源可及性和提高农业生产率方面的作用。

title: Valuing environmental quality: Evidence from Western Nepal
Through the looking glass: Environmental health economics in low and middle income countries
abstract: Human interactions with the environment can profoundly impact many outcomes – health being chief among them. While the nature of environmental risks changes across time and space, the burden of disease attributable to environmental risk hovers stubbornly around one quarter of the total global disease burden. Further, environmental risks are particularly damaging to the health of children, but also to the elderly and the impoverished in low and middle income countries (LMICs). This chapter highlights the ways in which economics provides analytical insight about the human–environment relationship and about potential ways to prevent diseases. Specifically, we contend that the household production framework – which focuses on the beneficiary and households – helps us understand when and how households will avert environmental risks. While economists have been mostly on the sidelines of environmental health research, there is a growing literature from LMICs that examines three aspects of reduction in household environmental risks: (i) how households value these risk reductions, (ii) what factors drive household adoption of environmental health technologies, and (iii) what are the impacts of these technologies on household health. At the risk of simplification, our review of this literature finds relatively low values for environmental risk reductions, which is mirrored by limited adoption of environmental health technologies and, accordingly, disappointing impact on health. Economists have made less progress in linking the literatures on valuation, adoption and impacts with each other. We conclude by explaining why the next wave of research should focus on these links and on multiple risks, environmental disasters, and political economy of the supply of interventions.
abstract_zh: 人类与环境的相互作用会深刻影响许多结果，其中健康尤为重要。尽管环境风险的性质随时间和空间不断变化，但可归因于环境风险的疾病负担始终顽固地占全球总疾病负担的约四分之一。此外，环境风险对儿童健康的危害尤为严重，对低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的老年人和贫困人口也是如此。本章强调了经济学为理解人与环境的关系，以及为预防疾病的潜在途径提供分析见解的方式。具体而言，我们认为，以受益者和家庭为核心的家庭生产框架有助于我们理解家庭何时以及如何规避环境风险。尽管经济学家在环境健康研究中大多处于边缘位置，但来自低收入和中等收入国家的文献日益增多，考察了降低家庭环境风险的三个方面：（i）家庭如何评价这些风险降低，（ii）哪些因素推动家庭采用环境健康技术，以及（iii）这些技术对家庭健康有何影响。虽有简化之嫌，但我们对这一文献的综述发现，对环境风险降低的估值相对较低，这与环境健康技术的有限采用相呼应，因而其对健康的影响也令人失望。经济学家在将估值、采用和影响这三方面文献相互连接方面进展较小。我们最后解释了为什么下一波研究应聚焦于这些联系，以及多重风险、环境灾害和干预供给的政治经济学。
